offering_description.value: IAC publishes consumer websites and magazines for readers and sells advertising to brands and agencies. Its marketplaces connect families with caregivers and healthcare employers with job seekers. It also produces films for distribution.

primary_products.value: Consumer websites; print and digital magazines; digital news publications; feature films

primary_services.value: Advertising and sponsored content; affiliate shopping referrals; caregiver matching; employer-sponsored care benefits; healthcare recruiting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Advertisers, media agencies, online retailers, employers, healthcare staffing agencies and film distributors; B2C: Readers, magazine subscribers, families seeking caregivers, care providers and healthcare job seekers

end_markets.value: Consumer publishing; advertising and e-commerce; family care; healthcare staffing; filmed entertainment

revenue_model.value: advertising: Digital and print ad placements and sponsored content; subscription: Magazine and digital news subscriptions and premium caregiver marketplace memberships; commissions or management fees: Retailer commissions on purchases referred through editorial shopping content; product sales: Individual magazine issues; licensing or royalties: Rights to distribute films or republish editorial content; project or contract: Employer care-benefit programs and healthcare recruitment packages
revenue_model.category: advertising; subscription; commissions or management fees; product sales; licensing or royalties; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: other: Commissions and edits journalism, photography and recipes for consumer publications that carry paid advertising; software / platform: Aggregates caregiver profiles and healthcare job listings for families, recruiters and job seekers; service provider: Administers family-care benefits for employers; OEM / manufacturer: Develops and produces feature films for distributors
value_chain_position.category: other; software / platform; service provider; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international media audiences and care marketplaces in Canada and parts of Europe

specialization.value: diversified: Lifestyle and news publishing, family-care marketplaces, healthcare recruiting and film production

distribution_channels.value: online: Owned media sites, newsletters and apps, plus caregiver and healthcare job marketplaces; direct sales: Sales teams serving advertisers, agencies, employers and healthcare recruiters; third-party retail: Newsstands, supermarkets and bookstores carrying print magazines; partners / resellers: Content syndication partners and film distributors
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FTC advertising and endorsement rules, consumer privacy laws, and background-screening rules for care and hiring marketplaces

notes: I’m uncertain which smaller businesses IAC still controls and whether it retains any search operations.
